ModMetaData.name: 机械师带宽条 / Mechanitor Bandwidth Bar
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
把生物技术的机械师带宽显示从「一格一单位」的格子改成容量进度条。原版在带宽较多时会不断加行并压缩格子，格子缩到几像素后渲染错位；本模组改用比例映射，任意带宽数量都不会溢出，并同时显示余量、孕育占用和超编数量。
Replaces the Biotech mechanitor bandwidth gizmo with a capacity bar. Vanilla keeps adding rows and shrinking cells as bandwidth grows, which breaks down once cells are only a few pixels wide. The bar maps bandwidth proportionally, so it stays readable at any count, and it shows free capacity, gestation usage and overflow.
不影响带宽数值、机械师机制、存档或其他界面。Does not change bandwidth values, mechanitor mechanics, saves or other UI.
